Ref: INF-TECH SUP-20

The Firm
GSA is an award -winning quantitative investment manager, focused on short term and high frequency
systematic trading across liquid equity, futures and foreign exchange markets globally.

GSA Capital was formed in 2001 as the Global Statistical Arbitrage group of DB Advisors, a proprietary trading unit of
Deutsche Bank. The team spun out of the bank in 2005 to create an independent hedge fund management company.

Today GSA manages a number of absolute return, alternative investment funds, aiming to deliver superior risk-adjusted
performance by systematically exploiting a range of market inefficiencies using quantitative techniques and innovative
technologies.

Our Culture
We reward people based on merit and excellence, not necessarily on experience. We avoid the bureaucracy of larger
organisations and keep our management structures flat. Decisions are made efficiently; changes are implemented
quickly.
People who work here enjoy a culture of trust, innovation and scientific rigour. We have some really creative, super-
smart people here; all of whom would be embarrassed to be described that way.

It’s a friendly, open place where people are motivated because they enjoy what they’re doing.

The Role
Technical Support
The role is a technical assistant to the IT Infrastructure team, primarily supporting the helpdesk function within the team. We are
looking for someone who has solid IT skills (PC setup, plugging in and setting up workstations, connecting network cables,
debugging physical PC issues) and experience with Windows, Linux, and Networking fundamentals. Extensive helpdesk or
support experience is not required. A keen PC user who is looking to continuously learn new skills & build a career in IT
Infrastructure is ideal.
IT helpdesk - General day-to-day work:

• Assist Infrastructure staff and complete user support tasks
• IT troubleshooting – Windows, Linux
• Relationship building with other departments, internal customers, suppliers, data vendors
• Equipment installation
• Network patching
• PC moves
• Desk setup

Candidate Attributes
• Genuine interest in technology
• Basic IT skills (physical PC setup, troubleshooting)
• Excellent customer service mentality
• Excellent communication skills
• Fast learner, autodidactic
• Confident presenting information in writing and verbally
• Confident telephone manner
• Good powers of persuasion
• Fluent English speaker, no other language requirements

GSA Capital Services Ltd
Stratton House, 5 Stratton Street, London W1J 8LA
www.gsacapital.com
GSA Capital Services Ltd is registered in England and Wales
at the above address, number 5320529.
